facts.fact: 指骨自愈：火焰逐指点燃——骨裂声与愈合同频；影缚遁逃
facts.anchor: With each crackle of flames the bones snapped and mended

facts.fact: 力量哲学定稿：她不只是“生火”——她就是火
facts.anchor: until she was not just producing fire, she was fire.

facts.fact: 火圈立威：白热力量压入手臂——火环围住她/Vasara/Gerrick 三人，谁也进不来
facts.anchor: a broad circle of flames surrounded the three of them.

facts.fact: 四系合璧：借破窗落雪放大水汽——沸腾之雨成片浇下，红眼乌鸦落地抽搐
facts.anchor: boiling rain poured down in sheets

facts.fact: 人质反转：Vasara 拿骨刃抵住 Gerrick 喉咙——他眼里没有恐慌只有爱意，眨眼示意“没事”
facts.anchor: the bone blade pressed firmly to his throat.

facts.fact: 黑根爆发：比她大腿还粗的黑根破地缠住 Vasara——魔法与她合一（用她的血供能）
facts.anchor: This magic was different. It was endless and powerful

facts.fact: 处刑：她拾起骨刃——“敢举他的骨头！”“Edgeron？替我问好”——一刀入心，Vasara 倒地
疗愈后的拒斥：不许他碰——放过你≠原谅你；翡翠触肤涌欲望“如老友相邀”
facts.anchor: “I may have let you live, but that doesn’t mean I want anything to do with you.”

facts.fact: 意识初见：苍白高挑、黑发红眼、领口黑纹、歪嘴一笑——Edgeron 亲自打招呼（声音如天鹅绒）
facts.anchor: It’s good to finally meet you, Andra.

facts.fact: 自我为宿主：为救 Gerrick（翡翠毁他即死）——割开胸骨把翡翠塞进胸腔；“Until my last breath”回敬他的遗言；黑暗吞没她
facts.anchor: In one swift movement, Andra cut a long line down the length of her sternum and shoved the emerald inside.
